task: Check if there are trade-in offers for the latest model of iPhone.
answer:
FINAL: Yes. As checked on October 27, 2026, Apple’s U.S. site offers $175–$885 in Apple Trade In credit toward its new iPhone Duo or iPhone 18 Pro when trading in an iPhone 13 or newer. The amount depends on the eligible device’s model, configuration and condition.

Apple also advertises carrier trade-in deals of up to $1,200 with AT&T, $1,000 with T-Mobile, or $840 with Verizon. These include carrier credits and are subject to eligibility and plan terms.

Source: https://www.apple.com/iphone/
Evidence: final.png shows the model names, Apple Trade In range and carrier offer amounts together.
